Generated Narrative: ValueSet ahip-relationship-status

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include these codes as defined in http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-MaritalStatus version 📦5.0.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    MMarriedA current marriage contract is active
    DDivorcedMarriage contract has been declared dissolved and inactive
    LSeparated
    WWidowedThe spouse has died
    TIn a registered domestic partnershipPerson declares that a domestic partner relationship exists.
    USingleCurrently not in a marriage contract.
  • Include these codes as defined in http://ahip.org/demographics/CodeSystem/ahip-demo-additional-relationship-status-codes version 📦0.1.0
    CodeDisplay
    DATIDating (in a non-committed relationship with one person or more than one person)
    MONRIn a committed relationship with one person but not married (monogamous relationship)
    POLYIn a committed relationship with more than one person (polyamorous relationship)
  • Include these codes as defined in http://ahip.org/demographics/CodeSystem/AHIP-Demo-Additional-NullFlavor version 📦0.1.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    PSINPlease specify if not listed above**Description:**This code is to represent explicitly that the patient would like to specify a value that is not listed above
    CNTRI choose not to respond at this time**Description:**This code is to represent explicitly that the patient has chosen not to respond to this question at this time
